defs.def: to suffer or die because you do not have enough food to eat; to make sb suffer or die in this way （使）挨饿，饿死

ex.s: Maybe that feeling comes from growing up in South Africa, where the phrase “there are children starving in Africa” was more of an uncomfortable reminder of fact than a prayer at dinner time.
ex.t: 应该如何____处理这样一个美丽的地方呢？
用有趣的故事逗读者笑。

defs.def: not having sth that you need 构成形容词

ex.s: Why do people have to starve when mountains of food are rotting away in other parts of the world?
ex.t: 当世界其他地方堆积如山的食物正在腐烂时，人们为什么要挨饿？

ex.s: An expert who has studied polar bears for many years said that from the position of its dead body, the bear appeared to have starved and died.
ex.t: 一位研究北极熊多年的专家说，从尸体倒下的位置来看，这只熊似乎是饿死的。

ex.s: One of our group members, Lionel Greenstreet, noted in his diary about how bored he was with the meals: “The food now is pretty well all meat of sea creatures.” If it weren’t for sea animals, we would all starve.
ex.t: 我们团队的成员之一，莱昂内尔·格林斯特里特，在日记中记录了他对食物的厌倦：'现在的食物几乎全是海生动物的肉。'要是没有海洋动物，我们全都会饿死。

ex.s: Cleared away plants and trees which meant animals starved.
ex.t: 清除了意味着动物会饿死的植物和树木。
